name: web-webcore-designer-toy-whitelist-hero-with-sticker-title
title: Webcore Toy Collectible Whitelist Hero
whatItIs: A mobile landing page on a dotted off-white ground with a black ticker strip of lime monospace slogans, a huge black bracketed '[MARK IT]' title with a pink offset outline and a blue round '555 QTY' sticker, a tilted black label 'Designer Toy Culture x Webcore Collection', a monospace paragraph and two glossy pill buttons in lime and sky blue.
whatItMeans: Bracketed type, hard offsets and glossy candy buttons mix toy culture with terminal aesthetics for a knowing, playful web3 tone.
techniques: Heavy title with a pink offset outline
Tilted black label as a strip of tape
Glossy candy pill buttons with a black underlay

vocabulary.definition: A style borrowing early-web and terminal visuals.
A band of scrolling slogans across the top.
A glossy rounded button with a hard shadow.
